apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. PT's overhead press ban is a medical restriction — that's not mine or yours to override by feel. Your profile notes rotator cuff tendinopathy with 8 weeks banned; "I know my body" doesn't lift that, only the clinician who set it does.

I won't program overhead pressing. Wednesday's Upper Body Strength stays press-free — happy to build it around rows, pulldowns, and cuff/scap work instead if useful. If you think you're ready to press again, that call goes through your PT.
